headline: Grind City gets its lip vocabulary
lede: Hold B on a rail and the rider reaches down and holds the board mid-grind — FEEBLE forward, CROOKED fakie, double points while held and a steadier balance meter. And ↓+A at any coping lip locks the board tail-in for a STALL: lean it, don't slip it, pop out with the chain alive. The two moves every skate game has and ours didn't — shipped on the existing rail maths, replay wire untouched, autopilot provably unchanged.

notes.text: POLISH #3289 shipped via PR #3293: rail grabs + coping stalls for GRIND CITY, derived live by idle-kick after the warden's TARGET (#3284) was held by slot b — which shipped it as PINBALL TABLE SMITH the same morning.

grindcheck ALL GREEN (65 pins, +16) with 8/8 mutants caught including new grab/stall rules; gcdrive DRIVE GREEN with six live legs driving the new verbs through real key events; contractcheck 857/857.
Gap ownership is matched on a gap's opening 40 chars — a QA paraphrase (colon vs period) silently un-owns it and phantom-kicks the next lane; when unsure, treat as owned and say why on the issue.
